title: Replicated Choices Match Deterministic Running
statement: Let $M$ be an oracle Turing machine, let $O$ be a language over its symbol alphabet, and let $x$ be an input word. For natural numbers $s,t$ with $s\le t$, running the nondeterministic oracle machine associated to $M$ with oracle $O$ on the first $s$ bits of a length-$t$ sequence of false choice bits, from its initial configuration on $x$, gives the same configuration as running $M$ with oracle $O$ for $s$ steps from its initial configuration on $x$.
hypotheses_covered: An oracle language $O$ over the symbol alphabet
